content.title: Residential structural design
content.intro: Permit-ready plans for custom homes, remodels, additions, decks and foundations. Fast, accurate and affordable.
content.overview: We engineer residential structures to pass plan check and build cleanly in the field. From removing a load-bearing wall to a new custom home, the goal is simple: move your project forward quickly and correctly, with clear drawings, concise calculations and responsive communication.

photo.alt: Looking up at a wood roof frame of rafters and beams against a blue sky with clouds.

items.title: Custom and luxury homes
items.body: Framing and lateral plans that work with the design; gravity, wind and seismic calculations.

items.title: Production homes
items.body: Value-engineered structural and foundation plans with clear, buildable details.

items.title: Remodels and additions
items.body: Removing bearing walls, floor and roof changes, decks and other additions.

items.title: Foundations
items.body: Spread footings, drilled piers and caissons, micropiles, helical piers.

items.title: Retaining and site structures
items.body: Cast-in-place concrete, masonry, gravity, Keystone and Redi-Rock walls.

content.heading: What you get
items: Permit-ready structural and foundation plans (PDF), with a stamped calculation package when your building department requires one.
Clear assumptions, schedules and early RFIs to keep the project moving.
Coordination with your architect or contractor during design, revisions for plan check comments, and answers to RFIs during construction.

content.heading: How we work
content.stepBody: Send drawings, sketches or site photos. We review the scope, ask the right questions and outline what a permit-ready package needs.

content.heading: Ready to get started?
content.body: Quick replies, clean drawings, and fair pricing.
